tasks.description: 1.1 Pin the accepted name raster and historical native texture replies, inventory all 21 original/private portrait containers with complete row and pixel contracts, add independent parsing/corruption tests and documentation, and verify their immutable report.

2.1 Continue all six retained branches through original texture conversion, cleanup and path/loader code to its first unexecuted allocation request using declared platform replay and actual read-only file open/size; independently verify full source/write traces, pixels/accounting/stack/all maps/CPU and owned cleanup; add boundary/identity corruption tests and documentation, then run affected regressions.

3.1 Run strict specs and the complete earlier-evidence/save/checkpoint preservation chain, record honest master progress and remaining allocator/image boundary, commit locally and archive the completed change; verify exact archive hashes and raw/index/HEAD bytes.

context:
本项目为 Cross Hermit 原版逆向与 Godot 重制工作区，两者的完成状态分开报告。
逆向总范围、完成标准、2026-11-20目标及待完成里程碑以
openspec/specs/reverse-engineering/completion/spec.md 为准。
add-fifth-week-school-planning 已于2026-10-20归档，是历史记录，不再追加任务。
其423–428未完成计划已迁入总规格R1–R6，不得当作已完成研究。
每次继续推进先接续对应的有效change；没有对应change时才为下一个有限功能里程碑创建change。
不为每次对话、每条消息或每个接口新建change，不将所有余下工作堆入一个持续扩张的change。
完成的规格同步到总spec后归档对应change；历史原始证据、原存档及私有检查点保持不变。
完成连贯工作单元后本地Git提交，不push。
